info.title: VLite REST API
info.description: Experimental API for one exclusively owned database. Bearer authentication is required except explicit loopback-only development mode. Optional distinct read-only credentials permit GET/HEAD outside /v1/admin/ and non-building collection search/retrieval POSTs; lazy approximate index builds and other writes require admin or an appropriately scoped credential. /health and static dashboard assets are public. Use --tls-cert/--tls-key for native HTTPS or terminate TLS at a trusted proxy. --grpc-tls-client-ca enables mandatory gRPC client certificates. Admin TLS reload validates all listeners before replacing certificates. Optional tenant-bound credentials, request rate limits, live-vector quotas and OTLP tracing are disabled unless configured. No CORS, automatic repair or retries. X-Request-ID and Cache-Control: no-store are included. IDs and administrative seeds use decimal strings; payloads use padded standard base64. JSON is limited to 8 MiB and 16 in-flight requests/workers. Successful writes are synced. Disconnects and commit_indeterminate errors do not prove writes failed; never blindly retry. Backups require VLITE_ADMIN_DIR; restore selection takes effect only on restart and never replaces the live owner. Token reload reads only configured files. See docs/CONSOLE-ADMIN.md for semantics, bounds and durability limitations. Protected operations may return 401, 403, 422, 429 (with Retry-After) or 503 with the Error schema.

Authenticated JSON or Prometheus metrics snapshot
get.description: Counters reset at restart; request duration totals cover completed middleware responses and exclude streaming body transfer. HNSW rebuild counters include explicit builds and lazy builds. HNSW timing includes explicit build duration or build plus the triggering query, not isolated build time for lazy queries. Metrics reads queue behind database work and fail 503 if busy or closed. Poisoned owners still expose failure counters with database_healthy=false and null database gauges. Live records, file bytes and buffer usage are gauges; other numeric values are cumulative. The current metrics request is counted but not yet timed.

get.summary: Bounded live-page listing of vector IDs and typed metadata only
get.description: Ascending numeric u64 order. after is an exclusive ID bound, not an opaque snapshot token and need not exist. Omitting after starts at the beginning, including ID 0. Concurrent writes between requests can change membership/metadata; inserts at or below the cursor will not appear in subsequent pages. No stable snapshot or total count is promised. A page is capped at limit records and 1 MiB serialized JSON, whichever occurs first; it can contain fewer than limit even when more data exists. Use next_after until null. Vectors and payloads are deliberately omitted. Empty/end pages have items=[] and next_after=null. Listing does not build an index or modify storage.

post.summary: Search the default collection with legacy parameter defaults
post.description: Supports exact, approximate, approximate_ready, auto and hybrid modes. Distance modes order ascending then numeric ID; hybrid ranks RRF scores descending. Auto never builds and may choose an indexed exact scan, full exact scan or ready ANN. Hybrid requires v4 and declared text fields for its nonzero text leg. Exact supports squared_l2, cosine and inner_product; ANN supports squared_l2/cosine. Strict-type AND filters are validated before readiness or empty-query handling. Nonmatching ANN nodes remain traversal bridges; ef_search bounds retained eligible candidates, not visited nodes or time. ANN has no hidden exact fallback. Scalar-u8 traversal reranks with current f32 vectors and does not promise total RAM savings. Lazy approximate may build synchronously: read-only credentials cannot build, and scoped credentials additionally need search_build. approximate_ready returns 409 on missing or mismatched index identity. Use collection routes to inherit persisted settings instead of this alias's hard defaults. explain adds work counters and an auto plan. See docs/CAPABILITIES.md for bounds and score semantics.

200.description: Hits ordered by distance ascending or hybrid score descending, then numeric ID. explain includes stats and optional plan.

429.description: Credential token bucket or live-vector quota exceeded; code rate_limited or quota_exceeded. Quotas require deleting records or reissuing configuration, not blind retries.

BearerAuth.description: Admin: VLITE_AUTH_TOKEN or configured file. Optional distinct read-only: VLITE_READ_ONLY_TOKEN or configured file. Scoped tokens use the vlk_ prefix and are returned once by credential creation/rotation. Never put credentials in URLs. See /v1/capabilities for effective role and scope.

SearchRequest.description: vector is required except in hybrid mode. Hybrid k is at most 1000 and ranks by score descending; other modes rank by distance ascending. Auto never builds an index; explicit approximate may build. Collection routes default to collection settings. explain adds stats, and an auto plan.

text.description: Hybrid only; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes and 32 unique tokens.

candidates.description: Must be at least k; defaults to max(k,50).

lambda.description: MMR relevance weight (default 0.5); only valid with mode=mmr.

Quantization.description: Index readiness identity includes quantization. Scalar-u8 traversal reranks candidates using current f32 vectors. No total-process-memory reduction is promised.

candidates.description: At least k; default max(k,50). Weights cannot both be zero.

CollectionSettings.description: REST updates merge supplied fields with current settings; v4 persists settings, legacy default collections report memory-only settings.

AnnMemory.description: Component accounting only, excludes allocator and process overhead. Original f32 records remain resident.

durable.description: False before the first chunk; an unused reservation does not survive restart.

collections.description: Explicit collection names or ["*"]. Grants bind collection identity, not a replacement with the same name.

expires_unix_ms.description: Mandatory future expiry, at most 365 days from creation.

tenant_id.description: Optional immutable tenant ID. Collection names become tenant-local; wildcard stays inside this tenant.

requests_per_second.description: Optional token bucket rate and capacity (one second of requests), shared by REST and gRPC. Resets on restart.

max_vectors.description: Optional aggregate live-vector cap across the credential collection scope (not historical writes).

max_vectors_per_collection.description: Optional live-vector cap in each writable collection.

seed.description: Administrative responses use decimal string for JS precision

grpc_requests_total.description: Accepted and rejected gRPC calls (also counted in requests_total)

grpc_request_failures_total.description: Failed gRPC calls, including failures after a stream was accepted

grpc_stream_messages_total.description: Streamed gRPC messages exported or received for import

Id.description: Canonical decimal u64, maximum 18446744073709551615; never a JSON number

Vector.description: Finite f32 components, exactly the database's dimension count

payload_base64.description: Canonical padded standard base64, decoded length <=1048576 bytes

ttl_ms.description: Relative lifetime in milliseconds; mutually exclusive with expires_at_ms

Metadata.description: Full replacement map; keys 1..256 UTF-8 bytes, string values <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, encoded map <=65536 bytes. Nonempty metadata requires file format v3. No nulls, nesting or arrays.

value.description: Canonical decimal signed i64 string, range -9223372036854775808..9223372036854775807

oneOf.description: At least one non-null min/max. Both bounds must be the same numeric type and min <= max; inclusive. String/boolean bounds are rejected.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or duplicate bearer authorization header

Upgrade.description: Nonempty batch requires v2+, nonempty metadata requires v3. Stop server and compact to a new current-version path; source is never upgraded in place.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, invalid ID, or invalid_if_match

InvalidInput.description: Schema or database validation rejected input; no write

Unavailable.description: Busy, closed, poisoned, or indeterminate commit. commit_indeterminate can mean the write succeeded. Do not blindly retry mutations.

PreconditionFailed.description: precondition_failed: If-Match does not equal the current record identity/content/revision, or the record is missing. V4 tags survive service restart; legacy tags do not. Nothing was written. GET again, re-apply the change and decide whether to resend; never retry automatically.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Optional. Exactly one strong entity tag copied byte-for-byte from the ETag of GET /v1/vectors/{id}. Checked and written under the database owner lock. Weak (W/), wildcard (*), comma lists and repeated headers return 400 invalid_if_match. Omit for unconditional behavior.

ETag.description: Strong opaque per-record tag bound to file identity, collection ID, record ID, last-put revision and full SHA-256 content digest. Unrelated writes do not invalidate it. V4 tags survive restart; legacy-file tags include a process nonce and do not. Copy-out maintenance changes identity. Do not parse.
